1.say: Check that. A Calorie measures the energy in food, not its temperature or weight.
hit: a calorie measures the temperature of food
calories tell you how hot the food is
a calorie is how much the food weighs
miss: A Calorie is the unit used to measure the amount of energy in food.
a calorie is a unit of energy it is not how much food weighs
calorie is the energy needed to raise the temperature of water
a calorie measures energy in food

3.say: Check that. Amino acids build proteins. What does fat do for the body?
hit: fat is a nutrient made of amino acids that stores energy
fat is built from amino acids
miss: Fat is a nutrient that stores energy, about 9 calories per gram, and insulates the body
fat stores energy and helps absorb fat soluble vitamins
fat insulates the body and is part of cell membranes

5.say: Check that. Vitamins and minerals are different nutrients. Which one is organic?
hit: a vitamin is a mineral the body needs in small amounts
vitamins are a type of mineral that is organic
miss: A vitamin is an organic molecule the body needs in small amounts.
a vitamin is organic but a mineral is inorganic
vitamins are not minerals they are organic and needed in small amounts

8.say: Check that. Empty-Calorie foods still have plenty of Calories. What do they leave out?
hit: empty calories are foods with low calories like diet soda
empty calories means the food has few calories
empty calories are diet foods
miss: Empty Calories are foods that supply Calories without the other nutrients the body needs, like chips and candy
empty calories give energy but not nutrients
they have calories but no vitamins or minerals
empty calories are not low calorie foods they have energy but no nutrients

9.re: \b(water|proteins?|vitamins?|minerals?|fats?|carbohydrates?|carbs?) (is not|isn't|isnt|are not|aren't|arent|is never|are never) (one|on the list|a nutrient|an essential|essential)\b
9.say: Check that. Water, carbohydrates, fats, proteins, vitamins, and minerals are all on the list.
hit: the nutrients are carbs fats proteins vitamins and minerals water is not one of them
proteins are not on the list
miss: The six essential nutrients are water, carbohydrates, fats, proteins, vitamins, and minerals. Cholesterol is NOT one of them.
water carbs fats proteins vitamins and minerals and cholesterol is not on the list
six nutrients water carbohydrates fats proteins vitamins minerals fiber is not one

10.say: Check that. Is that food mostly sugar or mostly starch?
hit: simple carbs are sugars and bread and pasta are simple carbs
candy is a complex carbohydrate
miss: Simple carbohydrates are sugars. The body absorbs them and uses them for energy quickly. Complex carbohydrates are starches. They must be broken down before the body can use them.
simple carbs are sugar like candy and complex carbs are starch like bread and pasta
bread is a complex carb and candy is a simple carb
bread is not a simple carb it is starch

10.say: Check that. Which kind can the body use right away, and which must be broken down first?
hit: simple carbs take longer to break down
complex carbohydrates are absorbed right away
miss: Simple carbohydrates are sugars used for energy quickly. Complex carbohydrates are starches that must be broken down first.
complex carbs take longer to digest and simple carbs are used right away
simple sugars are absorbed right away

11.say: Check that. Can the body digest fiber?
hit: fiber is a carbohydrate and the body digests it for energy
fiber is cellulose and your stomach breaks down the fiber
miss: Fiber (cellulose) is a complex carbohydrate the body cannot digest. It adds bulk that helps move food and waste through the digestive system.
the body can't digest fiber but it helps move waste
we cannot break down cellulose but we need it for bulk
the body does not digest fiber it pushes waste through

12.say: Check that. One is solid and one is liquid at room temperature. What do both do?
hit: similarity both are solid at room temperature
both have double bonds
miss: Saturated fats have only single bonds and are solid at room temperature. Unsaturated fats have one or more double bonds and are liquid. Similarity: both help the body absorb fat-soluble vitamins.
both help absorb fat soluble vitamins saturated is solid unsaturated is liquid
both store energy saturated is solid and unsaturated is liquid at room temperature

13.say: Check that. Building and repairing tissue is mainly a job of proteins.
hit: fats insulate the body and build muscle
fat is part of membranes and repairs tissues
miss: Fats insulate the body, are part of cell membranes, and help absorb fat-soluble vitamins. Fats are NOT hormones and enzymes; those are jobs of proteins.
fats insulate keep us warm make up membranes and absorb vitamins but they are not enzymes
fats do not build muscle that is protein and fats are not hormones

16.say: Check that. That job belongs to a different vitamin. What does vitamin C do?
hit: vitamin c is ascorbic acid and it helps your eyesight
ascorbic acid helps blood clotting
miss: Vitamin C is also called ascorbic acid. It helps wounds heal, keeps gums healthy, helps the body absorb iron, and maintains cartilage and bone.
vitamin c ascorbic acid heals wounds and keeps gums healthy
ascorbic acid helps absorb iron and keeps bones and cartilage strong

17.say: Check that. A food label shows the nutrients in a serving. What does that help you plan?
hit: a food label shows the price and expiration date
the label tells you how much the food costs
miss: A food label shows the amount of each nutrient in a serving. It helps a person plan a balanced diet with all the nutrients they need in the right amounts.
the label shows nutrients per serving so you can eat a balanced diet
it shows the amount of fat protein and carbs so you can plan healthy meals
